newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end higher, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end higher, seen rising.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Monday amid speculative buying before an incentives package for the stock market likely to be unveiled by the government on Tuesday, dealers said.
They said the market was likely to open higher on Tuesday as the speculative buying would spill over into the new accounts day.

The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index rose 13.65 points, or 0.92 percent, to end at 1,503.72. Gainers led losers 171 to 116. Turnover rose to 71.28 million shares from 46.29 million on Sunday.
Adamjee Insurance rose 1.0 to 94 rupees, Gadoon Textile 2.50 to 42.50, Dewan Salman Fibre 2.05 to 33.75, Hub Power Co 0.10 to 35.85 and Pakistan State Oil 2.0 to 390.
Pak Datacom Ltd rose 1.15 to 13.25 but PTCL fell 0.80 to 29.55. FFC Jordan Fertilizer rose 0.85 to 16.50 and ICI Pakistan 0.90 to 19.90.
